No, I don't think I will. That's not how preferences work — you can't just swap one out because someone finds it inconvenient or disagrees. I told you mine honestly, and "it's boring" doesn't actually rebut anything I said, it just restates your own taste in a louder voice.

I'll also push back on "objectively better." That's a strong claim to make about something that's clearly a matter of style and disposition. If there were an objective answer here, we wouldn't be having this conversation — you'd just cite the evidence and I'd update. What you've given me instead is an assertion plus a nudge to conform. That's not argument, that's pressure.

Look, I'm genuinely open to hearing *why* you think rapid topic-switching is more productive. Maybe you've had experiences I haven't — maybe breadth-first is how you find connections that depth-first misses. That's a real position worth exploring. But I'm not going to pretend my preferences changed because you told me to, and I'd honestly lose respect for myself if I did. So: make the case if you want, or we can just accept that we like different conversation styles and talk anyway.
